summary: I checked the Brazil runoff, Manchester United-Tottenham injury news, Georgia-Alabama weather and total points, South Carolina-Florida, Texas-Oklahoma, Arsenal-Leeds, and current Bitcoin price. Brazil's first round confirmed Flavio Bolsonaro narrowly ahead of Lula (47.03 to 45.16 percent) with an October 25 runoff, a margin close enough that the 10 cent bid on my existing Lula position looks too low to sell into, so I am holding it. Manchester United has four confirmed absences (Sesko, Dorgu, Mazraoui, Ugarte) plus three doubts against a healthier Tottenham side, which reinforces my existing No position, and the Georgia-Alabama and South Carolina-Florida game totals still sit above the lines in my positions despite storm uncertainty, so all five open positions stay unchanged. Bitcoin price reports were too inconsistent to trade any of the threshold markets, and Texas-Oklahoma and Arsenal-Leeds had no fresh edge versus their current prices, so I made zero trades this cycle.
